note: M610b (spec analyses/M610_spec.md Rev 1, R4): which stops a collect pass (run_ingest.py --collect-stops) may record and pass over. Collectable = the tool already has a ruling-bound acknowledgement for exactly that gate; everything else is a hard stop that ends the pass at once. A collect pass withholds the splice of every converted stage whose output bytes depend on the ack content (R7) and always rolls the tree back; it never acknowledges anything. Read from the tools' source on 2026-11-11; the converted hooks are in the tools named below (search for 'stop_protocol').

gates.gate: reading flip f_gen >= 0.5 on a sensitivity axis (FLIP_STOP)
gates.reason: scoped ack exists (M466): bound to master MD5 and the axes sha256, names exactly the flipped set, cites a ruling; the delta file carries the ack record, so output bytes depend on the ack
scoped ack exists (M426); collectable only when every stop of the stage is one of the two acknowledgeable stops

gates.gate: every other stop (O file binding, key sets, n_days, BASE, speedSplit / simultaneity ordering flips, allow-list deep diff)

gates.reason: M466 ack names exactly the actual stops and escalations; only a pure escalation list is collected, any stop (key set, type, CI exit, allow-list) keeps the stage a hard stop

gates.gate: M494 verdict 'depends on the resampling unit'
gates.reason: ack only gates the splice; the splice bytes are computed from the data, not from the ack content (R7: none depend on it)
a refused ack is a hard stop

gates.gate: overall verdict of the Warm-vs-Shoulder balance block changed (M504)
gates.reason: the flag is boolean; the block bytes do not depend on it

gates.gate: leaves outside the allow-list / regression leaves changed
membership / sensitivity check failed or escalation triggered
gates.reason: no acknowledgement mechanism exists; a ruling would need a new code path and its own spec

gates.gate: reconciliation mismatch; a stratum supported or a relaxed setting reaches support (exit 2)
gates.reason: no acknowledgement mechanism; a Director decision precedes any display change

deferred, not a defect: the gate fires at the end of the 46 minute stage and its splice writes the master and arrays; converting it needs the candidate-cache design (M610c C2) and its own audit; after M609 the stage is restored from its checkpoint on a rerun

gates.gate: M321 ladder monitor W2/W3 (release_check / semantic gate)
gates.reason: not an exit-3 stage; the ack record needs the CHANGELOG '## M###' heading of the milestone, which exists only after the run; carried by M575 terms and the M608 standing stop rule
hard gate by design (rules plus ack-bound conditions, M608 Director ruling); never a collect-pass stop
authoritative clean-environment gate; fails while a collect token exists
